groups.activity: buy the Galatine Prime relics she stocks, 1 Aya each

rows.label: Galatine Prime relics
rows.note: buy extra Blueprint relics: every one carries it as the Rare

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
Vaulted relics and the parts themselves still trade between players.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

rows.label: Galatine Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Meso G1 or Neo G3 or Neo G5 or Axi G1, Rare: 10% Radiant

rows.label: Galatine Prime Blade
rows.note: Lith S7 or Lith T3 or Meso C2 or Meso S2 or Meso S4 or Meso S6 or Neo N6 or Neo V2 or Neo V3 or Axi N4 or Axi O2 or Axi T11, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Galatine Prime Handle
rows.note: Lith H10 or Lith S5 or Meso O4 or Neo V2 or Neo Z1 or Axi K2 or Axi O1 or Axi V6, Uncommon: 20% Radiant

conditions: Refine the Blueprint and Handle relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Blade relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
